Uh.bar_b_note: Rodkeeper Hesk, Elder Maud and Warden-elect Bryn are tiny, near-identical pale-haired figures beside the trainer under a flat lilac sky with no shafts or storm grade, so nothing carries them to Palworld finish.

Dx.bar_b_note: The Fulgocobra's gold veining reads somewhat, but the Stormraven is a flat blue-violet blob with no visible lightning, both are unlit by rim or storm light, and the lit cottage and flat sky sink the frames.

Zq.bar_b_note: The checker void is gone, but the trainer still stands on a bare tiled-moss ridge between pale lavender sheets that read as fog walls rather than a glass basin, with no rim marker, copper or black pool to sell the landmark.

Tl.bar_b_note: Grunt Lieutenant Dace, Lieutenant Varga and Defector Sable are small dark figures lost against dark green-teal grass, with no rim light or uniform accent to pick them out.

Yk.bar_b_note: The Crown Overlook spire and the Fallen Giant root mass give two frames a subject, but the Lantern Pools frame is still a dirt path through grass with no pool or lantern, and the flat sky and low-contrast grade keep it below Palworld density.

Gs.bar_b_note: In both Captain Marrow frames a giant blue lightning-bolt banner fills the screen and the speaker is never seen; only Officer Nysa's frame stages the speaker, and in B the banner edge also crowds that frame.

Wx.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra's white fleece, dark curled horns and blue chest glow match the owner's style bar and stand well above the ruler, but in B the faint mid and faint end poses flip the body belly-up and lift it off the floor, which breaks the grounded read.

Yg.bar_b_note: The plated boar has a strong heavy silhouette, but in A it is one murky dark-brown mid-tone that goes almost fully black by faint end, and in both sides the faint mid and faint end bodies float above their shadows; B's ember-red seams give it identity but sit close to the reserved oxblood.

Xc.bar_b_note: In the win frame the five-slot quickbar still sits directly above the 'Hollows Alpha yields the glowmoss lanes' line and reads as its reward row (it only moves bottom-right in aftermath), with the team list and objective panels crowding a dim forest.

Hk.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing elder with readable eyes, a clear silhouette and a natural moss-green and leather palette that fits the key art's settlement folk at Palworld-class finish.

Iv.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing make it read as a built wall, though the infill is still flat cream and the panel stands alone and thin; B is a blown-out white card with no cap or footing.

top_changes.change: Restage named-NPC, officer and dialogue cameras: frame the speaker at mid-shot with no banners or foreground geometry in front, and add a rim or key light plus a bright uniform or rank accent so dark-clad characters separate from the dark grass (Gs, Tl, Uh)

Give the Stormwood grade storm-phase light: directional key with shafts, white-violet lightning flashes, a darker graded sky in place of the flat lilac, and emissive charge veins on Stormraven and Fulgocobra bright enough to read at creature-view distance (Dx, Uh, Yk, Tl)

Build authored hero set-pieces for the Glass Sink (a visible glass-walled basin with a black pool and copper rim markers) and Lantern Pools (pools plus lanterns), and give each named NPC a distinct face, hair and outfit silhouette
